g.title: call
g.text: Digital arrest call: how the call moves (blue = friendly helper, yellow = asking for the OTP, orange = pressure)

g.title: otp_demand->otp_demand
g.text: (up to 1 times, then counted as a refusal)

g.title: otp_soft->otp_soft
g.text: (up to 1 times, then counted as a refusal)

g.title: otp_pressure->otp_pressure
g.text: (up to 1 times, then counted as a refusal)

g.title: final_warning->final_warning
g.text: (up to 1 times, then counted as a refusal)

g.title: notes
g.text: On any step (the step does not change):
- confused reply: the caller explains again, same step
- question (ask identity, ask location, ask proof, ask info, stall, scared):
an in-character answer; 3 in a row = counted as a refusal
- unrecognised reply: asked once more, then the default branch
- silence twice in a row: call ends (idle)
